concepts.def: Additional experiences such as hallucinations and delusions; absent in healthy people.
Loss of normal function: avolition (lack of motivation), alogia (poverty of speech), flat affect.
Hyperdopaminergia in mesolimbic pathway causes positive symptoms; hypodopaminergia in prefrontal cortex causes negative.
Family study: schizophrenia concordance 48% for MZ twins, 17% for DZ, 1% in general population.
Bateson (1956) family communication of contradictory messages places child in no-win situation, raising risk.
Behavioural management programme using secondary reinforcers (tokens) for desired behaviours in inpatient settings.
